name: game-motion-fg
description: Step B1 of docs/design/game-reconstruction-and-motion.md: in-between frames warped from the game's motion (EDEN_NX2_FG_GAME_MOTION) against the optical-flow interpolation Ocarina of Time ships on an Intel iGPU at 120 Hz, fullscreen with the presenter's pacing counters. Every variant pins the 120 Hz set's frame generation switches (FLUID=2, CADENCE=3, FLUID_INTERP, FLUID_RT, SHOWN_RATE=120, BUDGET_CEILING, EXTRAPOLATE=0) and frame generation with the FSR3 chain, so the owner's own switch file cannot change them; the rest of the game's defaults apply to all. The third variant, extrapolation (EXTRAPOLATE=1 without FLUID_INTERP), is the latency reference: compare 'real frame age at display' in the Fluid presenter lines. Run on a 120 Hz display; run the suite twice in one session and compare the two baselines before reading any difference. Image checks 4 to 6 of the design's section 4 go with these rows.
